facility.name: Cathy Lynn
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care

provenance.note: Home-based program: street address, phone and provider name are not shown.

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: A child did not wash her hands after having her diaper changed. This was corrected at the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §747.3213(3))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations: The 3 dogs on the premises are missing vaccine records. This is scheduled for Febrary 2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: The tv was on playing PBS Kids with an 11 month old in the room. The tv was left on for over an hour and did not follow the activity schedule. This was corrected at the inspection when it was turned off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §747.2105(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training: Primary caregiver Cathy Lynn is missing 25 hours of annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures- Sanitizing the Diapering Area: The diaper changing area was not sanitized after using it for an 11 month old infant.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures- Sanitizing the Diapering Area (26 TAC §747.3307(d))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Enrollment Agreement: Operation has a total of eight children enrolled:  Two children had no files available;  Three of seven had no school information.  Three of four files did not have a health care statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Enrollment Agreement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations: Permit holder does not have current vaccination records for the four pet dogs.  They expired April/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Caregivers- Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR: Permit holder is not current on First Aid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Caregivers- Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §747.1303(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Develop and Follow: There was no written activity plan.  Permit holder did not have an activity schedule to follow to keep children occupied.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Develop and Follow (26 TAC §747.2102(a))

occurrences.finding: Sanitation of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The home was found in unsanitary conditions.   Bleach on the kitchen counter near food items.  Garbage exposed and accessible to children.  Significant amount of gnats were flying throughout rooms, around trash can and on garage door leading from kitchen.  The under sink cabinet in the restroom had Drano accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sanitation of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §747.3203)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plan: The emergency preparedness plan was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plan (26 TAC §747.501(12))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One of the four children files was missing a immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Two of the four children files was missing a healthcare statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Orientation for Household Members- Required: Two of the household members and permit holder did not have orientation available.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Orientation for Household Members- Required (26 TAC §747.1403)

occurrences.finding: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age: Children were observed sleeping on the couch, as mats weren't labeled with the children's name.     NOTE: Mats were labeled with the children's name.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age (26 TAC §747.4303(a))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: The TV was observed on during the inspection while two toddlers were eating cereal. In addition to one of the children using a tablet.    NOTE: This was corrected at inspection when tablet was placed in the child's backpack and TV was turned off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §747.2105(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Safe Sleep for Infants: The operational policy did not specify the sleep requirements and restrictions for safe sleep for infants 12 months old or younger.  -Pets requirements  -Promoting indoor and outdoor activities  -Duration of physical activities (indoor/outdoor)  -Recommended clothing  -Plan for weather permitting
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Safe Sleep for Infants (26 TAC §747.501(6))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required training less than- 5 years experience: Permit holder did not have six hours of management training available for review. .
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required training less than- 5 years experience (26 TAC §747.1309(e)(1))

occurrences.finding: Storage for Individual Belongings: Children backpacks were observed on a recliner in the living room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Storage for Individual Belongings (26 TAC §747.4305)

occurrences.finding: Electric or Battery Operated CO System-Test Documentation Available During Hours of Operation: Carbon monoxide was not documented for the month of February and March.     NOTE: This was corrected when it was tested and written on the Emergency practices.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electric or Battery Operated CO System-Test Documentation Available During Hours of Operation (26 TAC §747.5337(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuate and Relocate with Essential Documentation: The emergency preparedness plan did not specify what essential documents will be taken when evacuating.    Or how they plan on continue the same care during an evacuation.      And how you will reunify the children with someone not on the pick up list.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuate and Relocate with Essential Documentation (26 TAC §747.5003(3))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing Before Eating: Children were observed coming in from outside and not washing hands.    NOTE: This was corrected when the children were assisted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing Before Eating (26 TAC §747.3213(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child: One of the four children files did not have school age information or permission on their enrollment form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child (26 TAC §747.605(14))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Release Information: Three of the four children did not have release information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Release Information (26 TAC §747.605(7))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - No Play or Eating Surfaces Used: An infant was observed being changed using a changing mat on the sofa.    NOTE: A diaper changing pack and play was available to set up.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - No Play or Eating Surfaces Used (26 TAC §747.3303(b))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Soiled Diapers Kept in a Sanitary Manner: Dirty diapers were observed in the restroom trashcan in a unsanitary manner.     NOTE: This was corrected when the trash was taken out.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Soiled Diapers Kept in a Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §747.3307(e))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations: No current vaccination or healthcare statement were available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Three of the four children files did not have address to the emergency contacts.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §747.605(6))
